hypothesis: Original drawing systems and world appeal can return without surrendering clean surfaces or the clarity of controlled eight-beat action. Cast sheets and editable layout controls are tested as aids, not evidence of successful generated anatomy or owner approval.

01.name: Nightglass
01.treatment: Economical fine anime ink and softly modeled handsome faces; tailored light clothing against deep navy inhabited vertical city, cyan architectural light, elegant sweeping creature silhouette. Selective sharp edges and calm values, not glossy armored fantasy.

02.name: Sunbreak Lancer
02.treatment: Warm lively ink contours with angular opaque painted planes, bright azure/cream/coral/green, expressive appealing faces and colorful cloth sails over stacked sunlit architecture. Preserve painterly edge variation, not vector-flat or glossy.

05.name: Iron Orchard
05.treatment: Matte opaque gouache brush shapes, muted earthy olive/rust/cream and smoky blue, confident adult faces, industrial orchard rails and broad rust insect-machine forms. Soft painted edges and weight, not shiny cel armor.

06.name: Floodline Detective
06.treatment: Bold coarse black-and-white brush masses, expressive dry ink selectively at contours, one hot-pink accent, monumental concrete flood architecture. Broad black water with a few deliberate white ripples. Not gray photoreal textures.

13.name: Red Current
13.treatment: Energetic manga nib contours and selective directional hatching, white paper and strong solid black shapes, sparse red combat accent. Extreme concrete ramps and angular predatory forms; retain drawing energy without covering surfaces in hatch.

15.name: Cathedral Engine
15.treatment: Antique sepia engraving on clean pale parchment; curvature-following engraved line groups model form, confident adult faces, tall bell-engine city and grand mechanical ecology. Quiet unmarked fields between selective hatch, never flatten into cel shading.

17.name: Hollow Cartographer
17.treatment: Thin even warm outlines, flat muted peach/teal/cream storybook colors, soft atmospheric distance, immense salmon aqueduct arches and walking garden ecology. Clear charming adult faces and spacious architecture, no glossy rendering.

18.name: Soft Thunder
18.treatment: Rounded exaggerated hand-painted cartoon volumes, large expressive eyes and mouth, playful shape rhythm and appealing adult bodies, turquoise/orange/coral/cream palette, blue cloud creatures and windmill hills. Broad clean color and expressive contour, not rigid armored realism.

19.name: Black Petal
19.treatment: Refined soft near-real anime facial gradients, spare black tailored silhouettes and white collars, charcoal/ivory with restrained maroon, translucent black botanical petals and elegant oval negative spaces in a glasshouse. Selective petal translucency, no opaque ivory monster armor or pervasive veins.

NG.title: The bridge that pulls back
NG.identity: Aren: light-skinned adult man age28, narrow angular face, gray eyes, swept midnight-blue hair with short side undercut; off-white sleeveless asymmetric knee-length split vest over fitted black high collar and tapered black trousers, a single red fastening cord at chest, slim black boots, NO plate armor. RIGHT hand carries one solid 60cm crescent-edged short sword, black straight hilt, small cyan ring in pommel. Sera: light-skinned adult woman age33, strong square face, short copper bob, burgundy sleeveless thigh-length combat coat, charcoal fitted trousers and boots, straightforward black spear with pale triangular steel point, held two-handed. Distinct mature faces and silhouettes.
NG.world: An inhabited deep-navy vertical city skybridge: broad matte gray deck, one simple rail on each side, lift tower at frame-left end, open round doorway at frame-right end, a few cyan vertical window strips, green hanging plants and distant lower pedestrian bridges. One huge distant glass-wing ray with a broad crescent silhouette and sparse cyan nodes in the opening/ending views only. No cathedral courtyard, wet paving or pebble texture.

power.name: Tension Line
power.description: The sword pommel casts one rigid-looking thin cyan tether to a metal anchor. It can pull along that line, never push; a slack curved line carries no force.
power.limitation: Closing the distance makes the tether slack; pulling also loads Aren’s shoulder and stance.
power.growth: Redirect the same pull around a new anchor while preserving momentum.

BP.title: When the flower takes root
BP.identity: Ilyra: pale adult woman age30, elegant long oval face, narrow gray eyes, chin-length smooth dark-brown hair with one ivory underlayer visible at the nape; black fitted long split-tail coat, high white standing collar, dark pleated combat trousers, smooth silver LEFT forearm guard, slim black boots. RIGHT hand holds one slender silver single-edge saber with a simple open oval black guard; readable complete blade, no ornamental tangle. Mourning Bloom: enormous floating translucent charcoal flower, oval empty center, broad soft black petals with sparse silver edging; a long stout tapering black root descends to a single wide planted thorn foot when it attacks. No human mask, hands, ivory armor or bundles of threadlike roots. Its weight hangs above that root.
BP.world: A tall abandoned glasshouse, black curved structural ribs against pale mist, one white doorway on the left and a broken glass arch on the right. Broad matte maroon moss floor, a few large leaves only; no wet reflections, tiled rubble or repetitive veins. The flowering creature and human face are the detailed focal forms.

power.name: Root-Lock
power.description: The bloom must plant its thick root to launch a heavy petal strike; it cannot turn while that root remains planted; it must lift and reset the root before changing its facing.
power.limitation: Petals close into armor against frontal steel. The exposed weight-bearing root is vulnerable only while committed.
power.growth: Ilyra learns to bait the planted strike and cut its support from the flank.

ST.title: Borrow a breath
ST.identity: Tavi: light-skinned athletic adult woman age27, broad expressive face, large teal eyes, short curly coral hair tied into a high forward tuft, solid shoulders and powerful thighs; cropped turquoise sleeveless combat jacket over cream top, loose orange fighting trousers, red ankle wraps and broad cream boots. Paired rounded red combat gauntlets; LEFT gauntlet has a large cream crescent painted on its back, RIGHT gauntlet has a smooth cream circular pressure plate. Gale Ram: large living blue cloud ram, cream broad muzzle, orange circular cheeks, thick curled blue horns, four stout legs and one cloud tuft tail, readable animal construction; elastic body can squash, never duplicate legs. About twice Tavi’s standing height, expressive angry eyebrows, no armor.
ST.world: A broad dry cream chalk ledge above green windmill hills, coral-and-cream cloud banks, simple wooden safety post at left and rounded blue boulder at right. Grass as a few broad masses, no soil grain, reflective ground or stone tiling.

power.name: Stored Breath
power.description: Tavi’s RIGHT gauntlet compresses one wind pulse while both boots brace on solid ground. Release drives a short broad air wedge through the fist and kicks her backward.
power.limitation: It cannot charge while airborne; the recoil must be managed with her stance.
power.growth: Turn the recoil into a controlled pivot and use the next landing to reload.

entries.title: An empty breath
entries.caption: An empty breath. Ram’s cheeks are visibly deflated and mouth open as it finishes its long straight exhale toward Tavi’s old position. Ram cannot immediately inhale again. Clear empty blast lane away from her.

entries.title: Turn the sunlight
entries.caption: Turn the sunlight. Sun Wedge: a spear can redirect a leap only while its blade catches direct sunlight; shade cancels it. Growth: choose the angle rather than increase glare.
entries.brief: A new light-skinned adult male lancer with a freckled long face, wavy auburn hair tied back, cream short battle cape over coral light armor and green fitted trousers vaults a broad blue-and-green spear across the shoulder of a huge mirror-glass feline lunging past him. His two hands grip a single complete shaft; one boot pushes from a cream rooftop edge, the other leg folds naturally. The spear’s broad sunlit blade projects one flat warm wedge that redirects the cat’s next leap toward an empty sail rather than distant pedestrians. Colorful suspended cloth sails and stacked cream city against azure sky. Cat built from a few large angular transparent planes, no tiny shattered facets.

entries.title: Brace the orchard gate
entries.caption: Brace the orchard gate. Load Turn: gauntlets grip one joint and redirect weight only while her stance is braced; she cannot lift the machine outright. Growth: chain balance breaks.
entries.brief: A new imposing light-skinned adult woman age40 with strong brow, short silver undercut and warm dark eyes, ochre sleeveless padded combat coat, olive trousers and broad rust-red armored gauntlets braces one boot against a rail sleeper and catches the thick forelimb of a huge rust beetle-machine with both gauntlets. Her shoulder drives under its joint, twisting it sideways until the near leg buckles. A short broad combat cleaver remains sheathed at her hip, readable complete silhouette. Orchard rows, elevated rail truss and industrial gate recede in broad painted masses; dry matte earth, no grit speckle. Beetle has readable paired mechanical legs and a single green face lamp.

One hot-pink rectangular gate signal only; stark monumental concrete arches and broad water blacks, sparse white ripples, no repetitive spray.

entries.brief: A new light-skinned athletic adult man with an angular smiling face and long black hair in a compact braid, white sleeveless combat jacket over black fitted trousers, red rigid fighting gauntlets, punches a giant folded white ray-shark’s jaw upward as it dives through a concrete spiral ramp. The creature’s wings are broad black-and-white sheets with a few purposeful fold lines; distant ramp spirals give scale, no shard storm or all-over hatching.

entries.title: Unseat the bell
entries.caption: Unseat the bell. Counterweight: shield catches a loaded leg while mace releases its hinge; it requires the enemy’s own step. Growth: interrupt several linked machines through their rhythm.
entries.brief: A new regal light-skinned adult woman age45 with an aquiline face, silver braid, dark fitted long coat with cream lapels and split riding skirt over trousers, holds a large plain brass round shield in LEFT hand and compact flanged war mace in RIGHT. She drives the shield beneath a giant walking bell engine’s bent front leg while striking its pivot with the mace; her knees bend and both boots brace. The bell tilts bodily and one leg lifts, not a weightless explosion. Vast engraved bell-city towers rise behind in pale atmospheric layers. Sepia line groups curve around brass forms; broad untouched parchment ground, no checkerboard or metallic glints.

entries.caption: Hold the walking garden. Root Still: planted spear can halt a moving root briefly while both hands hold pressure; leaving the brace frees it. Growth: create safe passages through living terrain.
entries.brief: A new appealing light-skinned adult woman with a round determined face and a mass of warm brown curls, teal short cloak over cream light combat armor, orange sash and blue trousers, uses a plain long silver spear and small round teal forearm shield to pin a thick root-serpent against an aqueduct parapet. Both hands hold the spear; shield is strapped to LEFT forearm. Her feet brace on the salmon walkway, serpent neck bends visibly at spear pressure, no puncture gore. Beyond the enormous salmon arches, an immense walking garden tortoise carries a few trees and a small white tower through blue air; its long rootlike legs remain simple and readable. Spacious warm storybook flat colors, calm floor and thin even outlines.

support_entries.title: The bridge that pulls back — cast and equipment
support_entries.brief: Aren: light-skinned adult man age28, narrow angular face, gray eyes, swept midnight-blue hair with short side undercut; off-white sleeveless asymmetric knee-length split vest over fitted black high collar and tapered black trousers, a single red fastening cord at chest, slim black boots, NO plate armor. RIGHT hand carries one solid 60cm crescent-edged short sword, black straight hilt, small cyan ring in pommel. Sera: light-skinned adult woman age33, strong square face, short copper bob, burgundy sleeveless thigh-length combat coat, charcoal fitted trousers and boots, straightforward black spear with pale triangular steel point, held two-handed. Distinct mature faces and silhouettes.

support_entries.title: When the flower takes root — cast and equipment
support_entries.brief: Ilyra: pale adult woman age30, elegant long oval face, narrow gray eyes, chin-length smooth dark-brown hair with one ivory underlayer visible at the nape; black fitted long split-tail coat, high white standing collar, dark pleated combat trousers, smooth silver LEFT forearm guard, slim black boots. RIGHT hand holds one slender silver single-edge saber with a simple open oval black guard; readable complete blade, no ornamental tangle. Mourning Bloom: enormous floating translucent charcoal flower, oval empty center, broad soft black petals with sparse silver edging; a long stout tapering black root descends to a single wide planted thorn foot when it attacks. No human mask, hands, ivory armor or bundles of threadlike roots. Its weight hangs above that root.

support_entries.title: Borrow a breath — cast and equipment
support_entries.brief: Tavi: light-skinned athletic adult woman age27, broad expressive face, large teal eyes, short curly coral hair tied into a high forward tuft, solid shoulders and powerful thighs; cropped turquoise sleeveless combat jacket over cream top, loose orange fighting trousers, red ankle wraps and broad cream boots. Paired rounded red combat gauntlets; LEFT gauntlet has a large cream crescent painted on its back, RIGHT gauntlet has a smooth cream circular pressure plate. Gale Ram: large living blue cloud ram, cream broad muzzle, orange circular cheeks, thick curled blue horns, four stout legs and one cloud tuft tail, readable animal construction; elastic body can squash, never duplicate legs. About twice Tavi’s standing height, expressive angry eyebrows, no armor.
